summary: Iteration 3: tested the three new features — Check Into Experiment, Guide Link Suggestions, Before/After compare — plus regression. Backend pytest suite grew from 28 to 38 tests (10 new covering snapshots lifecycle + guide proposal accept for item/link/experiment + duplicate-link proposal rejection + user isolation on snapshots), 100% pass in ~7.6s. Frontend Playwright flow: logged demo user in via /signin (auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-btn), seeded a deterministic analysis (TEST_iter3 — an_1719b17906d2) with 2 patterns items + 1 learning + mutated map state + a direct-DB-injected guide_messages doc carrying a link proposal (pr_fe_link) and an experiment proposal (pr_fe_exp). Verified: (1) See stage shows compare-open-btn when a learning exists; opening it reveals compare-dialog with compare-loop-select, compare-map-before, compare-map-after, and diff sections compare-added (People align by osmosis), compare-relabelled (Specs unknown→known), compare-links-added — ringed nodes rendered on After map. (2) Guide proposal cards render for both types with data-proposal-type=link|experiment; experiment body (proposal-experiment-pr_fe_exp) shows all four rows If we try / Testing whether / Watching for / Timeframe. (3) Accepting the link proposal adds a link under links-section with 'Proposed by the Guide · confirmed by you' and card resolves to proposal-pr_fe_link-resolved. (4) Accepting the experiment proposal fires toast 'Experiment added to Decide', navigates to Decide to find the planned experiment with the prefilled action/hypothesis/signal/timeframe. (5) Timeline sheet contains both 'Confirmed a Guide link …' and 'Turned a Guide check into the experiment …'. (6) Mobile 390px: compare dialog scrolls and the two maps stack vertically (After y > Before y+height). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_analyses.add_learning writes the snapshot AFTER save_and_return bumps updated_at but BEFORE the learning is pushed — ordering is fine today (snapshot uses the pre-push items/links which is what we want), but it's subtle. Comment this intent.
GET /analyses/{id}/snapshots returns snapshots filtered client-side after Mongo fetch; could instead use an $in query on live learning ids to avoid pulling orphaned snapshots. Minor perf.

_accepted_record raises HTTPException from within save-helper call site; the proposal remains status=pending which is correct, but on duplicate-link accept the user sees the toast and the card stays actionable — intentional and good.
ProposalCard: accept button is disabled when text is empty for item/experiment but not for link (which has no editable text). This is correct and matches intent; worth a code comment.
BeforeAfterDialog diffMaps uses link id equality to detect links added; if backend ever regenerates link ids this would false-positive. Current backend uses stable lk_ ids so OK.
SystemMap renders <title> twice inside Node — harmless duplication but should be removed.

Guide system prompt now instructs 'propose links' and 'experiment on how-could-I-check'; LLM output is non-deterministic — product should be okay with occasional misses. Backend parse is strict and discards invalid proposals safely.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_a_/TEST_b_ users, TEST_snaps and TEST_props analyses, and inject synthetic guide_messages via direct Mongo (so the proposal accept endpoints are tested without LLM flakiness). Frontend: a TEST_iter3 analysis seeded under demo user with 2 items + 1 learning + mutated state + 2 pending synthetic Guide proposals (link pr_fe_link, experiment pr_fe_exp). Two proposals were accepted during the test — the analysis remains on the demo account for inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 3 suite covers: GET /analyses/{id}/snapshots lifecycle (empty→1→2 with second reflecting mutated items/epistemic, filtered by live learning_id, user-isolated), POST /guide/proposals/{id}/accept for type=item|link|experiment, duplicate-link proposal rejection at accept time, and 'cannot accept twice'. Backend tests use pymongo direct-insert into guide_messages to inject deterministic proposals. UI testids used: compare-open-btn, compare-dialog, compare-loop-select, compare-map-before, compare-map-after, compare-added, compare-relabelled, compare-revised, compare-removed, compare-links-added, compare-links-removed, compare-no-changes, compare-empty, learning-compare-{id}, proposal-{id}, proposal-{id}-resolved, proposal-accept-{id}, proposal-edit-{id}, proposal-text-input-{id}, proposal-kind-{known|inferred|unknown}-{id}, proposal-link-{id}, proposal-experiment-{id}, data-proposal-type on each proposal card. Seed helper: /app/test_reports/seed_fe.py (reusable for future iters). Leftover TEST_iter3 analysis on demo user can be deleted.
